name: OrderExecution
summary: This EA appears to be an order execution utility that manages trade order placement and execution logic, likely providing enhanced order management capabilities such as partial fills, split orders, or timed execution rather than generating its own trading signals.
summary_zh: 该EA是一个订单执行工具，主要功能是管理交易订单的下单和执行逻辑，可能提供增强的订单管理功能，如分批成交、拆分订单或定时执行，而非基于自身策略信号开仓。
strategy_analysis: 该EA作为工具类程序，不基于任何交易策略自主开仓。其核心功能围绕订单执行流程优化，可能包括市价单和挂单的智能执行。入场条件由用户手动触发或外部信号驱动，而非EA内部策略逻辑判断。出场条件同样依赖用户指令或预设的执行参数，如止损止盈的自动设置。仓位管理可能包含手数计算和分批下单功能，以减少滑点影响。资金管理方面，该工具可能提供固定手数或百分比风控的计算辅助，但不直接控制账户风险敞口。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA functions as a utility tool and does not open positions based on its own trading strategy signals. Its core functionality revolves around optimizing the order execution workflow, potentially including smart execution of market and pending orders. Entry conditions are driven by manual user triggers or external signal inputs rather than internal strategy logic decisions. Exit conditions similarly depend on user instructions or preset execution parameters such as automatic stop-loss and take-profit placement. Position sizing may include lot calculation and split-order functionality to reduce slippage impact. For money management, the tool may provide calculation aids for fixed lots or percentage-based risk control, but it does not directly control the account's risk exposure.

parameters.name: OrderType
parameters.description: 订单类型：市价单或挂单
parameters.description_en: Order type: market or pending order

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于识别本EA的订单

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description: 止损点数，0表示不设止损
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, 0 means no stop loss

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description: 止盈点数，0表示不设止盈
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points, 0 means no take profit

parameters.name: MaxRetries
parameters.description: 订单失败最大重试次数
parameters.description_en: Maximum retry attempts on order failure

pros: 作为执行工具，专注于订单执行质量优化，功能定位清晰
可能支持分批下单和重试机制，减少因滑点或拒绝导致的执行失败
与信号系统解耦，可配合任意策略使用，灵活性强
pros_en: As an execution tool, it focuses on order execution quality optimization with clear functional positioning
May support split orders and retry mechanisms, reducing execution failures caused by slippage or rejections
Decoupled from signal systems, can be used with any strategy, offering strong flexibility
cons: 不产生自主交易信号，完全依赖外部输入，无法独立运行盈利
如果缺乏适当的错误处理和状态检查，可能导致重复下单或订单丢失
工具类EA缺少回测价值，难以验证其在不同市场条件下的执行效果
cons_en: Does not generate autonomous trading signals, fully relies on external input, cannot run profitably independently
If lacking proper error handling and state checks, may lead to duplicate orders or order loss
Utility EA lacks backtesting value, difficult to verify execution performance under varying market conditions
improvements: 增加订单状态追踪和回执确认机制，确保每笔订单执行的可靠性
支持更复杂的执行算法如VWAP或TWAP，以减少大单对市场的冲击
improvements_en: Add order status tracking and confirmation receipt mechanism to ensure reliability of each order execution
Support more complex execution algorithms like VWAP or TWAP to reduce market impact of large orders

risk_points: 若缺少订单重复检查机制，可能在网络延迟时重复下单
若未对账户余额和保证金进行预检查，可能导致保证金不足时仍尝试下单
risk_points_en: If lacking duplicate order check mechanism, may place duplicate orders during network latency
If no pre-check on account balance and margin, may attempt to place orders when margin is insufficient

summary_en: This EA appears to be an order execution utility that manages trade order placement and execution logic, likely providing enhanced order management capabilities such as partial fills, split orders, or timed execution rather than generating its own trading signals.
